driverFormulas.rev: Net Sales = Gross Sales − Returns, Discounts & Member Bonus
driverFormulas.cogs: Cost of Goods Sold = Merchandise Cost + Freight & DC + Markdowns & Shrink
driverFormulas.gp: Gross Profit = Net Sales − Cost of Goods Sold
driverFormulas.gp-pct: Gross Margin % = Gross Profit / Net Sales x 100
driverFormulas.opex-excl: Operating Expenses = Store Personnel & Operations + Rent & Occupancy + Marketing, E-commerce, Logistics & HQ
driverFormulas.ebitda-pct: EBITDA Margin % = EBITDA / Net Sales x 100
driverFormulas.da: Depreciation & Amortisation = Store Fit-out + Right-of-Use + IT & POS
driverFormulas.ebit-pct: EBIT Margin % = EBIT / Net Sales x 100
driverFormulas.nonop: Net Financial Items = Finance Income − Finance Costs + Other
driverFormulas.ebt: Profit Before Tax = EBIT + Net Financial Items
driverFormulas.ni: Profit After Tax = Profit Before Tax − Income Tax
driverFormulas.ni-pct: Net Margin % = Profit After Tax / Net Sales x 100
driverFormulas.bs-assets: Total Assets = Current Assets + Non-Current Assets
driverFormulas.bs-ca: Current Assets = Cash + Receivables + Inventory + Prepaids
driverFormulas.bs-inv: Inventory = DC Stock + Store Stock + Goods in Transit
driverFormulas.bs-nca: Non-Current Assets = PP&E + Accum. Depreciation + Intangibles + Other
driverFormulas.bs-liab-eq: Total Liabilities & Equity = Current Liabilities + Non-Current Liabilities + Equity
driverFormulas.bs-cl: Current Liabilities = Payables + Accruals + ST Debt + Gift Cards
driverFormulas.bs-ncl: Non-Current Liabilities = Bank Facility & Leases + Deferred Tax + Provisions
driverFormulas.bs-equity: Equity = Share Capital + Retained Earnings + Other Reserves
driverFormulas.cfo: Cash Flow from Operating Activities = Profit After Tax + D&A + Working Capital
driverFormulas.cfi: Cash Flow from Investing Activities = CapEx + Disposals + Acquisitions
driverFormulas.cff: Cash Flow from Financing Activities = Borrowings + Lease Payments + Dividends
driverFormulas.cf-net: Net Change in Cash = CFO + CFI + CFF
driverFormulas.cf-end-cash: Ending Cash = Net Change + Beginning Cash
